cases.task: Choose the safe browser rule when EventSource reports a native transport error before the first ready handshake; an unknown named frame may already have changed the browser's internal Last-Event-ID without reaching application listeners.

required_facts.text: Before ready, the requested baseline has not been certified by the application protocol.
EventSource can consume an SSE id from an unknown named frame even when application code has no listener for that event name.
Automatic retry can send that opaque internal Last-Event-ID and a later ready could otherwise be mistaken for the first clean handshake.
After a valid ready, native transport errors may remain reconnectable if repeated ready cursors are monotonic.
